title: CoreWeave Stock (CRWV) Falls 0.5% to $48.73 (Nov 10)
summary: CoreWeave (CRWV) closed at $48.73 on Nov 10, down 0.51%, before Q3 results after the bell showed $3.661 billion revenue and raised 2026 guidance.
body_markdown:
## Why CoreWeave Stock Fell


None of the coverage reviewed for this article names a company-specific cause for Tuesday's small decline.[TheStreet](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/coreweave-inc-q3-2026-earnings-232125846.html) noted ahead of the release that CoreWeave was slated to report third-quarter 2026 results after the bell on November 10, so the numbers were not part of the regular session.


Instead, the stock moved with the market. Per[Investor's Business Daily](https://finance.yahoo.com/m/656fca57-9896-3dfb-96e8-e0af2bc227df/dow-jones-futures%3A-stock.html) , the stock market fell on Nvidia and surging Treasury yields. The US 10-year Treasury yield rose 10.0 basis points to 4.98% in the session.


After the close, CoreWeave published its[earnings report](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) . According to[the company's official release](https://investors.coreweave.com/news/news-details/2026/CoreWeave-Reports-Strong-Third-Quarter-2026-Results/default.aspx) , third-quarter revenue rose to $3.661 billion from $1.365 billion a year earlier, revenue backlog reached about $132.5 billion, and the net loss widened to $709 million, or $1.27 per share. The company raised its full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $13.0 billion to $13.3 billion and its adjusted operating income guidance to $1.275 billion to $1.375 billion.


As reported by[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/10/coreweave-crwv-q3-earnings-report-2026.html) , revenue topped the $3.55 billion analysts expected, per LSEG, and the shares advanced in extended trading. CNBC also noted that the stock had fallen about 40% over the past month heading into the report.


## CRWV Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- CEO Michael Intrator called it "a breakout quarter for CoreWeave, with revenue increasing by more than $1 billion sequentially," according to the company's release.
- Revenue backlog of $132.5 billion compares with $104 billion as of June, per CNBC.
- The new full-year revenue range sits above the $12.86 billion LSEG analysts expected, according to CNBC.


### Risks


- Total debt stood at almost $47 billion at the end of the quarter, according to CNBC. The outlet also noted that some CoreWeave bond yields have recently reached elevated levels.
- CoreWeave guided fourth-quarter interest expense to $1.05 billion to $1.15 billion and full-year 2026 capital expenditures to $37 billion to $39 billion, per its release.
- Higher yields shape its funding plans: finance chief Nitin Agrawal said, "At current yields, we do not intend to issue additional parent-level unsecured debt through 2027," as reported by CNBC.
